verdict.rationale: Muse explicitly supports linking email, calendar, and other apps/services, with user-controlled permissions and approval before actions, and can even write custom connectors for services with APIs (muse-docs-11, muse-docs-23, muse-docs-28, muse-docs-38, muse-docs-14). Cloud drive connection isn't explicitly named, though the VM/file system storage suggests broad file handling. Missing for 10: explicit mention of 'cloud drive' (e.g., Google Drive/Dropbox) integration, and independent hands-on verification that search/answers actually draw on connected email/calendar data.
